ex.en: It was online that I sold the clothes.
ex.zh: 我是在網路上賣那些衣服的。

ex.en: She goes online for several hours every day.
ex.zh: 她每天上網好幾個小時。

ex.en: The tickets for this attraction can only be bought online.
ex.zh: 這個景點的門票只能在網路上購買。

ex.en: I took an online course in photography.
ex.zh: 我上了一門線上攝影課。

ex.en: Online shopping is very convenient.
ex.zh: 網路購物非常方便。

ex.en: It's an ongoing investigation.
ex.zh: 調查正在進行中。

ex.en: The project is ongoing.
ex.zh: 這個專案正在進行中。

ex.en: We have ongoing discussions with several suppliers.
ex.zh: 我們正持續和幾家供應商洽談。

ex.en: Place the deck of cards on the oaken table.
ex.zh: 把那副撲克牌放在橡木桌上。

ex.en: Your keys are on the table.
ex.zh: 你的鑰匙在桌上。

ex.en: You don't have to go to school on Sunday.
ex.zh: 你星期天不用上學。

ex.en: The meeting is on Monday morning.
ex.zh: 會議在星期一早上。

ex.en: She gave a talk on climate change.
ex.zh: 她做了一場關於氣候變遷的演講。

ex.en: Do you have any books on marketing?
ex.zh: 你有關於行銷的書嗎？

on.zh: 處於…狀態（on vacation、on sale 等）

ex.en: She would willingly come but she was on vacation.
ex.zh: 她很樂意來，但她正在休假。

ex.en: These shoes are on sale this week.
ex.zh: 這雙鞋這週在特價。

ex.en: Is the air conditioner on?
ex.zh: 冷氣開著嗎？

ex.en: What's on TV tonight?
ex.zh: 今晚電視演什麼？

ex.en: I have one brother and two sisters.
ex.zh: 我有一個哥哥和兩個妹妹。

ex.en: We need one more chair.
ex.zh: 我們還需要一張椅子。

one.zh: （代替前面提過的名詞）那一個、…的那個

ex.en: American kitchens are much bigger than Japanese ones.
ex.zh: 美式廚房比日式廚房大得多。

ex.en: The mother bird brought worms for her young ones.
ex.zh: 母鳥叼蟲回來餵小鳥。

ex.en: I don't like this shirt. Can I see that one?
ex.zh: 我不喜歡這件襯衫，可以看看那件嗎？

ex.en: To share one's passion is to live it fully.
ex.zh: 分享自己的熱情，就是充分地活出它。

ex.en: One can't help many, but many can help one.
ex.zh: 一個人幫不了很多人，但很多人能幫助一個人。

ex.en: One day, I'd like to start my own business.
ex.zh: 總有一天我想自己創業。

ex.en: I met her one morning at the station.
ex.zh: 某天早上我在車站遇到她。

ex.en: Your camera is only half the size of mine.
ex.zh: 你的相機只有我的一半大。

ex.en: It only takes five minutes.
ex.zh: 只要五分鐘就好。

ex.en: Meg was the only girl that was wearing jeans.
ex.zh: 梅格是唯一穿牛仔褲的女生。

ex.en: This letter is the only key to the mystery.
ex.zh: 這封信是解開謎團的唯一線索。

ex.en: I check my email once a day.
ex.zh: 我一天收一次電子郵件。

ex.en: I've only been to Japan once.
ex.zh: 我只去過日本一次。

ex.en: Once there lived an old man in a village.
ex.zh: 從前，有位老人住在一個村子裡。

ex.en: Once there lived a king whose name was Alfred.
ex.zh: 從前有位名叫阿爾弗雷德的國王。

ex.en: Once you finish the report, send it to me.
ex.zh: 報告一完成就寄給我。

ex.en: Once you get used to it, it's easy.
ex.zh: 一旦習慣了，就很簡單。

ex.en: You had better get away from here at once.
ex.zh: 你最好立刻離開這裡。

ex.en: Start at once, or you will miss the bus.
ex.zh: 馬上出發，不然你會趕不上公車。

ex.en: Having met him before, I recognized him at once.
ex.zh: 因為以前見過他，我立刻就認出他了。

ex.en: Take the medicine at the onset of symptoms.
ex.zh: 症狀一出現就要服藥。

ex.en: The onset of winter brought heavy snow.
ex.zh: 冬天一來就下了大雪。

ex.en: From November onwards, it gets colder.
ex.zh: 從十一月開始，天氣會變冷。

ex.en: I will follow your advice fully from here onwards.
ex.zh: 從現在起，我會完全聽從你的建議。

ex.en: The store is open from 9 a.m. onwards.
ex.zh: 這家店從早上九點開始營業。

ex.en: Onwards and upwards.
ex.zh: 不斷前進，更上一層樓。

ex.en: We walked onwards until we reached the village.
ex.zh: 我們一直往前走，直到抵達村子。

ex.en: I'd like two one-way tickets from A to B.
ex.zh: 麻煩給我兩張從 A 到 B 的單程票。

ex.en: Round trip or one-way?
ex.zh: 來回還是單程？

ex.en: Be careful not to drive the wrong way on a one-way street.
ex.zh: 小心不要在單行道逆向行駛。

ex.en: This is a one-way street, so you can't turn here.
ex.zh: 這是單行道，你不能在這裡轉進去。

ex.en: The train arrived on schedule.
ex.zh: 火車準時到了。

ex.en: Summer arrived in June, right on schedule.
ex.zh: 夏天在六月如期到來。
